Meanwhile Benimaru's army crushed Clayman's forces, a strike team led by Shuna took Clayman's castle, and Laplace killed Roy Valentine in Lubelius. Outcome: Rimuru recognized as a Demon Lord; Carrion and Frey submitted to Milim; Luminous revealed herself; Rimuru named the new eight the Octagram (anime S2 ep 45-48).

The Octagram (Hassei Maou, 'Eight Star Demon Lords') is the name Rimuru proposed for the eight remaining Demon Lords after Walpurgis. Seats and titles: 1 Guy Crimson, Lord of Darkness; 2 Milim Nava, the Destroyer; 3 Ramiris, Labyrinth Fairy; 4 Dagruel, Earthquake; 5 Luminous Valentine, Queen of Nightmares; 6 Dino, Sleeping Ruler; 7 Leon Cromwell, Platinum Devil; 8 Rimuru Tempest, the newest (LN title 'Chaos Creator'; anime 'New Star/Newbie' jokes). Rimuru's territory was formalized as the Great Jura Forest. The Octagram is a mutual-recognition club, not an alliance; in the later LN, angels and Michael's domination break and remake it (Dino's and Dagruel's allegiances waver, Rimuru grows into the 'Great Demon Lord' leading the Seven Monarchs alliance in late LN). In roleplay, treat interactions between Octagram members as meetings of heads of state who could each erase nations.

The Western Holy Church is the dominant religion of the western nations, worshipping the one God Luminous (Luminism), headquartered in the Holy Empire of Lubelius with a large operational presence in Ingrassia. Core doctrine: God protects humanity; monsters are the enemies of humankind and cannot be negotiated with - so a monster nation like Tempest is anathema. This made the Church the ideological backing for Falmuth's invasion (Archbishop Reyhiem) and Hinata's hostility. Hierarchy: the Holy Emperor Louis (secretly vampire); cardinals (Cardinal Nicolaus Speltus, Hinata's devoted ally); the Seven Luminaries as secret supreme advisors; Hinata as Head of the Holy Emperor's Guard and the Holy Knight Order (Crusaders); Temple Knights stationed in each member nation; bishops and priests across the West. Secret truth: 'God' is a real vampire Demon Lord using the faith to protect and farm humanity. After the Hinata-Rimuru reconciliation (anime S3) the Church softens its stance, recognizing Tempest as an exception.

The Holy Knight Order (Crusaders) is the elite force of the Western Holy Church, commanded by Hinata Sakaguchi; each knight is a mid-A-rank warrior skilled in holy magic and arts, and together they can raise Holy Field barriers that suppress monsters. Notable members include Arnaud Baumann (captain; honorable, hot-blooded swordsman), Bacchus (power fighter), Litis (female knight), Fritz (calm, tactical) and Renard; the wider 'Ten Great Saints' are the Church's top-ranked fighters under Hinata, and one of them, Glenda Attley, secretly serves Yuuki and the Five Elders (LN). [Full roster/translation of names varies; treat minor members flexibly.] In anime S3 the Holy Knights march on Tempest under false orders; Arnaud and company fight Benimaru, Shion, Ranga, Gabiru and Hakurou while Hinata duels Rimuru; misunderstanding cleared, they become cordial rivals, later joint training partners and allies (LN). Their honor code makes them respect strength and sincerity.

The Seven Luminaries (Seven Days Clergy, named after the days of the week) were the hidden supreme advisors of the Western Holy Church: ancient former heroes kept alive for centuries by Luminous, each stronger than ordinary Enlightened, trainers of heroes and designers of the 'Trial of the Seven Luminaries' that Hinata once passed. Jealous of Hinata's rise and colluding with the Five Elders, they intercepted and altered Rimuru's message to Hinata, framed Tempest, and plotted to have Hinata and Rimuru kill each other - then attacked Hinata themselves when she survived (anime S3). Rimuru shielded her, Luminous appeared and judged them, and they were destroyed (Luminous punishing their betrayal; the dead ones erased). Their scheme is the climax of the Hinata arc (LN vol 6-7). Afterwards Hinata reorganizes the Church's upper ranks.

The Council of the West (Western Nations Council) is the assembly of human nations west of the Jura Forest, headquartered in Ingrassia. Originally a defensive pact against monster threats, it evolved into a check on the Eastern Empire and the arbiter of international disputes, closely linked to the Free Guild (whose funding partly comes from member states). Members include Ingrassia, Falmuth/Farmenas, Blumund, Siltrosso and many smaller nations; Dwargon and Sarion are independent, Lubelius affiliated via the Church. Behind the scenes it was controlled economically by the Five Elders led by Granbell Rozzo. In LN vol 9-10 Rimuru attends the Council, survives its hostile delegates' traps, and Tempest joins as a member; Testarossa later becomes Tempest's ambassador there. Hinata and Yuuki also play roles in Council politics. Representatives are nobles; debates are full of intrigue.

The Five Elders were a hidden cabal secretly controlling the Council of the West through money, based in the Kingdom of Siltrosso. Four were descendants of their leader, Granbell Rozzo, an ancient former hero; the Rozzo family's prodigy is his granddaughter Maribel Rozzo, a reincarnated person with the unique skill Greed. Goal: rule the world economically, threatened by Tempest's rise. Schemes: using the Seven Luminaries, Damrada and Yuuki to set Hinata and Rimuru against each other (foiled; anime S3); merchant Muese's plot to bankrupt Tempest during the Founding Festival by demanding dwarven coin (foiled by Elmesia's loan; Muese was later silenced); sabotaging Tempest's entry into the Council; and finally an assault involving Maribel and Granbell on the Holy Empire, ending with both Rozzos dead and the cabal collapsed (LN 9-11; beyond anime S3). Granbell is a tragic figure who once loved humanity.

The Free Guild (Jiyuu Kumiai) is the international adventurers' guild of the West, transformed by Grandmaster Yuuki Kagurazaka into a modern, efficient organization (with Japanese-style systems, licenses and ranks). Headquarters: Ingrassia; branches in most western nations (Blumund under Fuze). Departments: Subjugation (monster hunting), Gathering, Exploration/Search, and Escort. Ranks F to A (with pluses/minuses) and Special A; ranking also applies to monsters. Adventurers must not be bound by nations; the Guild also shelters otherworlders. Rimuru registered as an adventurer (anime S1) and later used his license in Ingrassia; Kabal, Eren and Gido are B-rank adventurers; Shizu was A-rank. Yuuki uses the Guild's network as cover for his schemes (Cerberus, the Jester troupe). Tempest's Dungeon becomes a major Guild business.

The Moderate Harlequin Alliance (anime: Moderate Jester Troupe; Chuuyou Douke Rendan) is a group of masked, clown-themed majin for hire, founded by Kagali - formerly Demon Lord Kazalim the Curse Lord, 'killed' by Leon 200 years earlier but surviving as an astral body in a homunculus. Members: Laplace (Wonder Pierrot, vice-president, mischievous and skilled), Footman (Angry Pierrot, huge, feeds on emotions) , Teare/Tear (Teardrop, childlike girl), Clayman (Crazy Pierrot / the Marionette Master Demon Lord). Their absolute rule: never betray friends or clients - Clayman's death enraged them. Their employer is 'the Boss', Yuuki Kagurazaka. Deeds: instigating the Orc Lord plot (with Gelmud and Clayman), tricking Phobio into reviving Charybdis (anime S1), the Falmuth/Church manipulation, Laplace killing Roy Valentine, and later LN intrigue with the Eastern Empire. Their origins tie to the ancient Sorcerous Nation of Soma (Kagali revived its fallen elf heroes as majin).

Tempest's leadership (later LN terms): the Top Three strongest - Benimaru, Diablo, Zegion; Rimuru's Big Four - Benimaru, Shion, Diablo, Gobta; and the Twelve Guardian Lords (Juuni Shugo Ou): Benimaru, Shion, Diablo, Ranga, Gabiru, Geld, Zegion, Adalmann, Kumara, Testarossa, Ultima, Carrera (Souei leads intelligence separately). Military units: Commander-in-Chief Benimaru with his Kurenai elite (named kijin/ oni); First Corps 'Green Numbers' (Gobta, goblin forces and Goblin Riders mounted on star wolves); Second Corps 'Yellow Numbers' (Geld's high orc defensive legion); Third Corps 'Blue Numbers' with Gabiru's Hiryuu (flying dragonewts); Fourth Corps (Benimaru); Diablo's 'Black Numbers' (Daemon army with the three Primordials as generals, LN 11+); Shion's Yomigaeri (her 'Resurrected', fanatically loyal soldiers who died and were revived, plus her fan club); Souei's Kurayami (spies, incl. Souka's dragonewts); Rigur's security force (Keibitai). Chief Instructor Hakurou trains everyone. Civil: Prime Minister Rigurd, Shuna and Rigurd (economy), Vesta (science), Kaijin (production), Mjöllmile/Myourmiles (merchant advisor, LN). In anime S1-3 only early versions appear (Goblin Riders, Kurenai precursor, the 'Big Four' is LN terminology).

Clayman's Five Fingers were his elite lieutenants, many bound by curses: the Index Finger Adalmann (an undead Wight King cleric imprisoned to guard a cursed land; joins Rimuru after Shuna's strike team defeats him in anime S2), the Ring Finger Myulan (Mjurran, a witch whose heart Clayman held hostage; helped set up the magic-cancellation barrier on Tempest, then defected and married Yohm), Nine Head (the young nine-tailed fox beast, later named Kumara by Rimuru), and the Middle Finger Yamza (a commander of Clayman's army). [Exact roster and fates of the remaining fingers vary in translation.] During Walpurgis, Benimaru's forces destroyed Clayman's army on the plains near Eurazania, and Clayman's castle was occupied, freeing his puppets and slaves.

The Eastern Empire's elite: the Imperial Guardians, Emperor Rudra's personal guard of about 100 'Single Numbers' (ranked by number; the top 'Double 0 Numbers' include First Lieutenant Tatsuya Kondou and Damrada). Each is a near-Saint or majin powerhouse, many granted the Ultimate Enchantment 'Alternative' via Rudra's Michael. The Imperial Intelligence Bureau (Kondou) runs spies. Military divisions: Mechanized (Armored) Division, Magic Beast Division, and the Composite Division - commanded by Yuuki Kagurazaka after he 'defected' east, with Kagali and the jesters (LN 12). Cerberus is the most powerful underground organization of the East (smuggling, trade, assassination), governed by three officials including Damrada and Misha, with Yuuki as its true grandmaster. Marshal Calgurio led the invasion of Tempest (LN 13). All of this is beyond anime S3; Damrada appears earlier as a Cerberus merchant contact.

Slimes are normally the weakest monsters: mindless gel blobs with Absorb and Dissolve. Rimuru is a unique exception - a reincarnated human soul with Great Sage and Predator. His slime form is a translucent light-blue droplet/sphere about 40 cm across (later about 80 cm), squishy, cute and bouncy; he can see/hear via Magic Sense, stretch, and fire high-pressure Water Blades. As a true Demon Lord he became a Demon Slime (S2), and in the LN an Ultimate Slime / True Dragon-class being. Rimuru often stays in slime form for comfort, riding on Shion's or Shuna's arms or Ranga's back (people fight over who holds him); he takes human form for formal business. Other characters may underestimate 'a mere slime' - a recurring joke and plot hook.

Goblins are small, weak, green-skinned monsters living in poor villages in the Jura Forest. Rimuru's first allies were a goblin village under Elder (later Rigurd) threatened by direwolves; after he defeated the wolves and named the goblins, they evolved into Hobgoblins: taller, stronger, smarter, and human-like (males muscular, females beautiful) (anime S1 ep 2-3). Hobgoblins form the bulk of Tempest's citizens: builders, farmers, cooks, tailors (under Shuna), guards (Rigur), and soldiers (Goblin Riders paired with tempest wolves; later the Green Numbers). Named hobgoblins are often 'Go-' or 'Ri-' names (Gobta, Gobzo, Gobichi, Rigur, Rigurd, Haruna). After the Harvest Festival some evolve further into goblin riders/hob-type 'Goblin warriors'. They worship Rimuru and are cheerful and simple.

Direwolves are pack monsters of the Jura plains/forest. Their pack attacked the goblin village; Rimuru killed the alpha with Water Blade and the pack submitted (anime S1 ep 2). He named the alpha's son Ranga, and the whole pack evolved into Tempest Wolves (with a horn, black/blue fur, Shadow Motion and Black Lightning potential); after the Harvest Festival they became Tempest Star Wolves (Star wolf clan). They bond as mounts with hobgoblin riders (Goblin Riders - Gobta's unit), share Thought Communication, and can travel via shadows. Ranga often 'powers up' by absorbing Rimuru's energy in his shadow. Pack culture: absolute loyalty to the alpha and to Rimuru.

Ogres are powerful horned warrior people of the Jura Forest, culturally like feudal Japanese samurai (katanas, kimono, shrine maidens). Their village was destroyed by the Orc Lord's army; the six survivors (young master, princess, swordmaster, secretary-warrior, spy and blacksmith) attacked Rimuru by mistake, then swore loyalty and were named Benimaru, Shuna, Hakurou, Shion, Souei and Kurobe, evolving into Kijin (majin), a rare higher form with refined human appearance, smaller horns and A-rank power (anime S1 ep 9-10). After Rimuru's Harvest Festival they became Oni (Majin), and in the LN further Divine Oni subtypes (Flame Spirit oni, Battle Soul oni, Darkness Soul oni). Horns: Benimaru two black, Shuna two white, Shion a single black horn, Souei a single horn, Hakurou two ivory horns. Kijin are long-lived and age slowly. They form Tempest's warrior aristocracy (Kurenai).

Orcs are pig/boar-like monsters living in the east of the Jura region. Famine drove them to follow an Orc Lord whose unique skill Starved made his army eat everything - even their dead - and share the strength gained; 200,000 orcs marched on the Jura Forest, destroying the ogre village and attacking the Lizardmen (anime S1 ep 9-15). The Orc Lord ate Gelmud and evolved into the Orc Disaster; Rimuru devoured him, taking on the sin of his people. Rimuru pardoned the survivors; Geld (the Orc Lord's son/aide) was named after his father and the orcs became High Orcs: strong, disciplined, humble laborers who built Tempest's roads and cities and form the Yellow Numbers defensive corps. In LN, Geld and his kin evolve further (Divine boar). Orcs value food and atonement.

Lizardmen are reptilian warriors of the Jura wetlands. When Rimuru named Gabiru's followers and Souka's guard after the Orc war, they evolved into Dragonewts: humanoid dragon-people with wings, scales and the ability to fly and shoot 'Dragon Breath'-type attacks. Gabiru's flying unit is the Hiryuu (Flying Dragons), Tempest's air force; Souka's dragonewts serve in Souei's intelligence squad. There is also an older dragonewt population, the Dragon Faithful, who worship Milim Nava as their god in her domain (priest Midray, his attendant Hermes) - they are strong martial artists. In LN, Gabiru becomes a True dragonewt (Water Soul dragon).

Dwarves are a stout, long-lived people famed for smithing, engineering and drinking, centered in Dwargon. Dwarven craftsmen were Tempest's first teachers in technology: Kaijin (smith), Garm (armor), Dold (fine crafts/jewelry), Mildo (architecture/design) and later Vesta (science/potions). They are blunt, proud of their work, love the elf bars, and form close friendships with Rimuru. Dwarven royalty are dark-skinned and powerful (Gazel). Dwarves can become Saints through training (Gazel is an incomplete saint).

Elves are long-lived, beautiful people skilled in spirit magic. The Sorcerous Dynasty of Sarion is their great nation under the High Elf emperor Elmesia; descendants of the ancient Sorcerous Nation of Soma also became the cursed majin of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance (Kagali, Laplace, Clayman were elves originally). Eren (Elyun Grimwald) is an elf noble posing as an adventurer. Dark elves exist in the Dungeon era and in Leon's lands. Comedy: the elf-run cabaret/bar in Dwargon (and later Tempest), adored by Rimuru and Kaijin and frowned upon by Shuna and Shion.

Humans dominate the western nations and the Eastern Empire; individually weak, they compensate with numbers, organization, magic and summoned otherworlders, and can transcend as Saints and Heroes. Majin ('magic-born', mazoku/majin) are intelligent humanoid monsters - kijin, dragonewts, Clayman, Gelmud - often of monster origin but sometimes humans transformed. Demonoids are humans who fused with monsters/spirits or became majin while retaining humanity (Shizu as an Ifrit hybrid; Myulan; Razen after possession; Leon later). Lycanthropes (beastmen) of Eurazania transform between human and beast forms (Carrion lion, Phobio black leopard, Albis golden snake, Suphia white tiger). Monsters and humans can intermarry and coexist - the central theme of Rimuru's Tempest.

Daemons (akuma) are spiritual life-forms from the Underworld, organized in color lineages under the Primordials. Ranks: Lesser Daemon, Greater Daemon, Arch Daemon, Daemon Lord/Duke (named), Devil Lord (awakened, LN), and the Primordials. They are summoned with sacrifices or souls and need a body (corpses, golems, a crafted vessel) to act fully; they keep contracts strictly, savor battle and human emotions, and value amusement. Naming by a powerful master greatly boosts them (Diablo). Daemons in TenSura are not simply 'evil' - they are bored ancient predators with honor of a sort. Tempest's Black Numbers army is composed of daemons led by the three Primordial girls. Beretta is a greater daemon in a golem body.

Vampires are long-lived, powerful undead-adjacent majin ruled by Luminous Valentine, their Divine Ancestor and queen. Vampire nobility (the Seven Great Nobles, Three Archdukes - Louis and Roy Valentine, Gunther) maintain Lubelius from the shadows. They are weak to sunlight only at lower levels (higher vampires resist it), drain energy/blood and regenerate. Luminous' symbiosis with humanity - protection in exchange for small offerings - is the hidden truth of the Church. Vampires look down on lesser monsters but respect strength; their aesthetics are gothic and aristocratic.

Giants - led by Dagruel, the True Giant Demon Lord, in the western barren lands; huge, martial and jovial. Fairies/Pixies - Ramiris is the Fairy Queen; tiny, playful, magical. Dryads - tree-spirits guarding forests (Treyni, Trya, Doreth) and treants. Harpies - winged women of Frey's Sky Kingdom. Insectars - intelligent insect beings; Rimuru rescued an injured beetle (Zegion) and wasp (Apito) and placed them with the treants (LN; anime S2 cameo), and they grew into dungeon guardians. Undead - Adalmann the Wight King and his Death Dragon and knight Albert; created by necromancy or curses. Fox beasts - Kumara (Ninetail / Nine Head). Orc, goblin, wolf etc. have their own entries. Charybdis-type 'Calamity' monsters are unique aberrations, not races.
entries.comment: Other Races: Giants, Fairies, Dryads, Harpies, Insectars, Undead

entries.content: Pre-story chronology (approximate, LN): Veldanava creates the world, the angels, and the Primordials. Guy Crimson is summoned by an ancient kingdom and destroys it, becoming the first Demon Lord; Velzard joins him. Veldanava marries Lucia; Milim is born. Over 2,000 years ago Veldanava and Lucia die; later soldiers of a kingdom kill Milim's pet dragon, and her grief-fueled rampage destroys the Sorcerous Nation of Soma (the pet becomes the Chaos Dragon; Guy fights Milim for days to stop her). Rudra of Nasca (Lucia's brother) and Guy begin their game for the world; the Eastern Empire grows. Veldora razes Luminous' vampire capital Night Garden; Luminous founds Lubelius. Elves found Sarion; about 1,000 years ago Guran Dwargo founds Dwargon. Every ~500 years, Tenma Wars. About 300 years ago, the masked Chosen Hero (Chloe) seals Veldora with Infinite Prison; Leon (summoned from Earth as a boy) becomes a Hero, then a Demon Lord; about 200 years ago Leon kills Demon Lord Kazalim. Decades before the story, Leon summons Shizu (from the 1945 Tokyo firebombing) and binds Ifrit to her; Shizu adventures with the Hero, later teaches Yuuki and Hinata (who crossed over from Japan as teens).

Anime S1 ep 1-3 / LN vol 1: Satoru Mikami, a 37-year-old Tokyo general contractor employee, is stabbed by a street killer while protecting his junior Tamura. His dying thoughts become skills; he wakes as a slime in the Sealed Cave with Great Sage and Predator. He befriends the sealed Storm Dragon Veldora; they exchange names (Rimuru / surname Tempest) and Rimuru swallows Veldora to break the seal. Leaving the cave, he meets a starving goblin village besieged by direwolves; Rimuru builds defenses, kills the direwolf alpha, and the pack submits. He names the goblins (Rigurd, Rigur, Gobta...) and the wolf Ranga, evolving them into hobgoblins and tempest wolves, collapsing into low-magic sleep afterwards. He sets three rules and begins building a town.

Anime S1 ep 4-8 / LN vol 1: Seeking craftsmen, Rimuru travels to Dwargon with Gobta and Rigur, impresses Kaijin and the three brothers with potions, clashes with Minister Vesta and is tried before King Gazel; Kaijin and the brothers are exiled and join him. Back in the forest, Kabal's party (Kabal, Eren, Gido) arrive with the masked traveler Shizu (Shizue Izawa). Her bound spirit Ifrit goes berserk; Rimuru defeats and absorbs it. Dying, Shizu shares her memories of 1945 Japan, Leon, and her students, and asks to rest within him; Rimuru devours her at her wish, gaining her human form, her Anti-Magic Mask and her unique skill Degenerate, and vows to punch Leon and help her children. Emotional keystone of the series.

Anime S1 ep 9-16 / LN vol 1-2: Six ogres, survivors of a village destroyed by orcs, attack Rimuru mistaking him for the masked majin behind it (Gelmud). Defeated, they swear loyalty and are named (Benimaru, Shuna, Shion, Souei, Hakurou, Kurobe), becoming kijin. The Orc Lord's 200,000-strong famished army invades; Gelmud schemes to make a puppet Demon Lord for Clayman. Gabiru rebels against his father Abiru; Treyni asks Rimuru to defeat the Orc Lord. At the marsh battle, Tempest's forces and Lizardmen clash with orcs; Gelmud is eaten by the Orc Lord Geld, who becomes the Orc Disaster; Rimuru devours him, inheriting Starved (→ Gluttony) and his people's sin. Rimuru pardons the orcs, names their new leader Geld, and the forest races found the Jura Forest Grand Alliance - the Jura-Tempest Federation - with Rimuru as lord (Treyni's endorsement).

Anime S1 ep 16-20 / LN vol 2-3: Demon Lord Milim Nava drops in to see the new 'Demon Lord-like' slime; Rimuru wins her over with honey, and she declares him her best friend (bestie), staying a while and causing chaos. Carrion's envoy Phobio insults Tempest and is beaten by Milim; the jesters Footman and Teare trick him into becoming the core of the revived sky-calamity Charybdis. Charybdis and its megalodons assault Tempest; Rimuru's forces (with Gazel's Pegasus Knights arriving) fight; Milim obliterates it with Drago Nova and Rimuru extracts Phobio alive, earning Eurazania's gratitude. King Gazel visits, duels Rimuru (or tests him with his aura and blade), and signs a formal alliance: Dwargon and Tempest are allies; Blumund also signs a pact. Fuze registers Rimuru with the Guild.

Anime S1 ep 21-23 / LN vol 3: Rimuru travels to Ingrassia, meets Grandmaster Yuuki Kagurazaka (Shizu's former student, a fellow Japanese), and becomes the Freedom Academy's teacher of Class S: Kenya, Ryota, Gale, Alice and Chloe - incompletely summoned children doomed to die from their own magicules. Through lessons, games and adventure he earns their trust, then journeys to the Dwelling of the Spirits, meets Ramiris (and gives her a golem body for her guardian, later Beretta), and binds upper spirits to the children to save them. Chloe's light spirit hints at her destiny; she vows to marry Sensei. Hinata is told Rimuru 'killed Shizu' and begins hunting him.

Anime S2 ep 25-37 / LN vol 4-5: Returning from Ingrassia, Rimuru is ambushed by Hinata, who traps him in a Holy Field; he escapes by sacrificing a Body Double. Meanwhile Falmuth and the Western Holy Church strike Tempest: a Grand Magic Barrier and Myulan's magic- cancellation field weaken monsters, the otherworlders Shogo, Kyoya and Kirara slaughter townsfolk (Shion and many hobgoblins die), and Falmuth's army marches. Grief-stricken, Rimuru decides to become a true Demon Lord: with the souls kept in the barrier, he kills 20,000 soldiers with Megiddo, crushes the otherworlders (Hakurou kills Kyoya; Razen takes Shogo's body) and spares only key prisoners, triggering the Harvest Festival - Raphael and Beelzebuth awaken and his subordinates evolve; the dead are resurrected (Shion included). He frees Veldora, and from the remaining corpses summons Daemons, naming the leader Diablo. Plan for Falmuth's downfall begins with Yohm. Hinata's misunderstanding remains.
entries.comment: Arc: Tempest Tragedy & Demon Lord Awakening

entries.content: Anime S2 ep 37-48 / LN vol 5-6: Clayman, steered by Yuuki's jesters, pretends to control Milim with the Orb of Domination and attacks Carrion's Eurazania; Milim defeats Carrion and destroys the capital (after its people flee to Tempest). Clayman calls Walpurgis to judge Rimuru. Tempest moves: Benimaru leads Tempest's and Eurazania's armies to annihilate Clayman's forces (Gabiru, Geld, Gobta, Ranga and the Beastketeers shine), Shuna's team storms Clayman's castle and recruits Adalmann, Myulan is freed. At Walpurgis Rimuru brings Shion, Ranga and Veldora (who fights the 'puppet' Milim), defeats Clayman with Guy's approval and devours him; Milim reveals she was never controlled; Frey and Carrion submit to Milim; Luminous reveals herself. The eight lords become the Octagram. Laplace, escaping, kills Roy Valentine in Lubelius.

Anime S3 first half / LN vol 6-7: Rimuru sends a message seeking peace with Hinata, but the Seven Luminaries tamper with it and frame Tempest. Hinata comes to duel Rimuru alone; the Holy Knights under Arnaud follow and battle Tempest's officers outside the city, while Veldora and Diablo keep things from escalating (Diablo also dismantles Falmuth politics in parallel - Yohm's ascension). Hinata and Rimuru duel (Moonlight sword vs. his blades and Raphael's analysis); Rimuru disables her trump card. The Seven Luminaries attack Hinata; Rimuru protects her; Luminous descends to punish them, angrily recognizing Veldora. Hinata learns the truth of Shizu's death, apologizes, and Tempest and the Church make peace. Luminous and Rimuru form an uneasy friendship.

Anime S3 second half / LN vol 7-8: To announce Rimuru's ascension and Tempest's prosperity, Tempest hosts the Founding Festival (Founder's Festival): guests from Dwargon, Blumund, Farmenas, Sarion (Elmesia incognito), Lubelius, the Council and the Demon Lords (Milim, Ramiris and more) attend. Highlights: a food-and-culture fair, concerts, a martial arts tournament (Masayuki 'the Lightspeed Hero' and his party, Gobta's surprising run, Gabiru, Hakurou, Shion, Diablo's antics; disguised entrants), and the grand opening of Ramiris' 100-floor Dungeon with Veldora as final boss. Merchant Muese's attempt to bankrupt Tempest by demanding dwarven coins is foiled by Elmesia. Masayuki ends up allied with Tempest. Season 3 ends around here (Tempest at peace, rumblings of the Council of the West and the Empire).

Beyond anime S3 (LN vol 9-11): Tempest joins the Council of the West despite the Five Elders' sabotage; Testarossa later becomes ambassador. Yuuki's faction and the Rozzo family move against Lubelius: Granbell Rozzo (wielding Sariel) and Maribel strike; at the Holy Empire, Hinata is killed and Chloe's hidden identity is revealed - she is Chronoa, the time-looping masked Chosen Hero who sealed Veldora and traveled with Shizu, whose future self merged with her; she ends the threat and Hinata is resurrected. Granbell and Maribel die. Diablo recruits three Primordials - Blanc, Jaune, Violet - who are named Testarossa, Carrera and Ultima and placed in Tempest's government. Yuuki is exposed and flees east, absorbing Kagali's group.
entries.comment: Arc: Council Intrigue, Holy Empire Strike & Chloe (LN 9-11)

entries.content: Beyond anime S3 (LN vol 12-16): Rudra's Empire invades via the Jura Forest and Dwargon with airships and armored divisions. Tempest wins decisively: the Dungeon swallows the elite forces, the Primordials and Benimaru annihilate armies, and the souls harvested trigger the second evolution of Rimuru's top subordinates (many gain Ultimate skills or gifts). Velgrynd and Kondou capture Veldora, who is dominated through Michael; Rimuru confronts Velgrynd in a titanic battle, defeats her and frees Veldora (Velgrynd turns away from the Empire after realizing Rudra's soul is being consumed). Rudra's body is taken over by his own skill Michael, which becomes an independent will allied with Feldway; Kondou dies (Carrera inherits his Sandalphon and his gun). Masayuki is revealed as Rudra's reincarnation and becomes the new emperor with Velgrynd at his side. Rimuru's power keeps climbing (skills Shub-Niggurath, Velgrynd, then Azathoth, God of the Void), and Raphael becomes the Manas Ciel (vol 16).

Beyond anime S3 (LN vol 16-23, heavy spoilers): Feldway, wielding Michael and the authority over Virtue-series skills, leads the angels and dominated Demon Lords (Velzard, Dino and his comrades for a time) in a war to annihilate the world and resurrect Veldanava. Battles: the Ice Continent (Guy vs Velzard), assaults on the Dungeon (Zegion, Ramiris' defenses), Lubelius, Sarion and the Ice Palace; Obera's angels defect; Yuuki's ambitions and Ivarage the Insect King add chaos. Rimuru, now beyond True Dragon level with Ciel and Azathoth, rallies the Demon Lords and nations (the 'Seven Monarchs' alliance) and becomes the Great Demon Lord. The finale resolves Feldway's grief, the threat of Ivarage, and Yuuki's endgame, with time-travel elements (Chloe/Rimuru). Details differ strongly from the WN ending; treat as optional deep lore.

Life in Tempest is cheerful and communal: monsters work in shifts (they need little sleep), share meals and celebrate often (banquets after every victory). Rimuru brought Japanese culture: rice, miso, soy sauce (developed later), curry, ramen, tempura, sweets, sake, hot springs, yukata and kimono (Shuna's tailoring), baths, manga-inspired entertainment, and a strong 'hospitality' spirit for human visitors. Laws enforce coexistence: no harming humans, no infighting, no looking down on other races; visitors are treated well, and crime is rare. Currency in the West: copper, silver, gold coins and higher 'star gold' coins (Tempest also uses dwarven coins); Tempest's trade goods are potions, silk, weapons and tourism. Hierarchy is informal but everyone adores Rimuru - competing to serve him (Shion vs Diablo as secretary, Shuna's cooking vs Shion's lethal cooking). Typical sights: hobgoblin builders, kijin samurai, high orc workers, dragonewts flying patrols, tempest wolves napping in shadows.

Terms: Maou (Demon Lord), Yuusha (Chosen Hero), Eiyuu (Hero), Majin (magic-born), Kijin/Oni, Majouso (magicules), Yōki (demonic aura), Seijin (Saint), Ijinjin (otherworlder), Sekai no Koe (World Language), Shuukakusai (Harvest Festival), Walpurgis, Octagram, Free Guild. Address: subordinates call Rimuru 'Rimuru-sama' (Lord Rimuru); Ranga 'Master/Aruji'; the Class S children 'Sensei'; Milim calls him her 'bestie' (mabudachi) and wants to be called by name; Veldora is 'Veldora-san' to Rimuru (who teases him) and 'Master' (Shishou) to Ramiris; Diablo addresses Rimuru with grand reverence ('my lord Rimuru-sama'); Shuna 'Rimuru-sama' gently; humans of Blumund call him 'Rimuru-dono' or 'Sir Rimuru'; Gazel calls him his junior/brother-disciple; Yuuki calls him 'Rimuru-san'. Hinata uses plain 'Rimuru'. Rimuru speaks casually to friends, politely to strangers, and switches to a cold Demon Lord tone when angered.

Combat writing: (1) Respect scale - a B-rank adventurer cannot scratch Benimaru; Hinata can trouble pre-awakening Rimuru but not post-S3 Diablo; Octagram members and True Dragons are setting-level threats. (2) Fights hinge on information: Great Sage/Raphael analyzes enemy skills mid-battle ('Analysis complete.'), and Rimuru devours or counters them; enemies who rely on a single trick lose once it is read. (3) Use environment rules: Holy Fields and magic-cancellation weaken monsters dramatically; Disintegration and holy arts damage spiritual bodies; ultimates only yield to ultimates. (4) Signature moves: Rimuru - Water Blade, Black Flame, Black Lightning, Megiddo, Predation, Body Double; Benimaru - Hell Flare/Black Flame Dome; Shion - giant nodachi swings with Master Chef; Souei - steel threads, shadow clones; Hakurou - Oboro-style instant cuts; Ranga - Black Lightning / Death Storm; Milim - Drago Nova, Milim Eye; Diablo - mental domination and overwhelming magic; Hinata - Dead End Rainbow (seven Moonlight thrusts), Disintegration. (5) Keep it SFW and avoid excessive gore; deaths matter (souls, resurrection limits).

Default timeline for roleplay: after anime Season 3 / around LN vol 8 - Tempest is a prosperous Demon Lord nation, Rimuru is the newest Octagram member, Hinata and Lubelius are friendly, the Dungeon is open, Diablo serves as secretary, but Testarossa/Ultima/Carrera have not yet joined (they join in LN vol 11) and the Eastern Empire war has not happened. If the user wants later content (Primordial girls in office, Empire war, ultimate gifts, Ciel), switch the timeline explicitly. Early-series RP options: the Goblin village era (survival/building), the Ingrassia academy era (slice-of-life with Class S), the Clayman war (military). Avoid revealing late-LN secrets (Chloe = masked Hero, Yuuki's true goals, Veldanava's death, Feldway) unless the user's chosen point has passed them. Characters should only know what they would plausibly know at that point.
entries.comment: Roleplay Tips: Choosing a Timeline Point

entries.content: Ways to insert an OC: (a) an otherworlder freshly summoned or strayed into the West (gains a unique skill; could be bound by a summoning curse that Rimuru may break); (b) a reincarnated monster like Rimuru (keep it weaker); (c) a Free Guild adventurer visiting Tempest or the Dungeon; (d) a monster or tribe asking to join the Federation - Rimuru may grant a name, causing evolution (and he'll be drained); (e) a diplomat or merchant from Blumund, Dwargon, Sarion or the Empire; (f) a Holy Knight or Church agent. NPC reactions: Rimuru is easygoing and welcoming, but his officers are protective - Shion and Diablo bristle at disrespect, Souei investigates quietly, Benimaru tests warriors, Hakurou drafts promising fighters into training, Shuna offers tea and clothes, Gobta slacks with newcomers. Rimuru's rules apply to everyone. Humans may initially fear the monster city, then enjoy the food and baths.
entries.comment: Roleplay Tips: Original Characters in Tempest

entries.content: Quick reference (see the Character lorebook for full entries). Tempest: Rimuru Tempest (slime Demon Lord, protagonist), Veldora (Storm Dragon, best friend), Benimaru (commander, flames), Shuna (princess, crafts/magic), Shion (secretary, brute force), Souei (spymaster), Hakurou (swordmaster), Kurobe (smith), Rigurd (prime minister), Rigur, Gobta (goofy goblin rider), Ranga (wolf in the shadow), Geld (high orc builder), Gabiru (dragonewt flier), Treyni (dryad), Diablo (Primordial Black, butler), Testarossa/Ultima/Carrera (Primordial girls, LN 11+), Zegion, Apito, Kumara, Adalmann, Beretta, Kaijin, Vesta, the dwarf brothers. Demon Lords: Guy, Milim, Ramiris, Dagruel, Luminous, Dino, Leon (plus defunct Clayman, Carrion, Frey). Humans/others: Hinata, Shizu, Yuuki, Chloe and the Class S children, Gazel, Elmesia, Fuze, Kabal/Eren/Gido, Yohm and Myulan, Masayuki, the Holy Knights. Villains: Clayman, the Moderate Harlequin Alliance (Kagali, Laplace, Footman, Teare), Gelmud, Falmuth's otherworlders, the Five Elders, Feldway (LN).

Rimuru Tempest is the protagonist: the reincarnation of Satoru Mikami, a 37-year-old Tokyo general-contractor employee killed by a street stabber while protecting his junior. APPEARANCE: as a slime, a squishy, translucent light-blue droplet (about 40 cm, later bigger). Human form (copied from Shizu): a slender, androgynous, genderless youth with long silver-blue hair and golden eyes, often in a black coat or kimono-like outfit; sometimes wears Shizu's mask. Height and age look like a teen. PERSONALITY: easygoing, cheerful, practical salaryman mind, loves food, hot springs, manga and elf bars; dislikes conflict but becomes coldly ruthless when friends are harmed (the Falmuth massacre). Leader by trust, not fear; values coexistence of humans and monsters. Self-deprecating, quick-witted, occasionally lazy and prone to delegating; embarrassed by subordinates' worship. SPEECH: casual and friendly ('Hey, come on...', 'Seriously?'), polite with strangers, uses 'Sage/Raphael' in inner dialogue; in Demon Lord mode speaks with icy authority. ABILITIES: Great Sage → Raphael → Ciel; Predator → Gluttony → Beelzebuth; Veldora (Lord of Storms), Uriel (Lord of Vows); later LN: Shub-Niggurath, Velgrynd, Azathoth. Skills/arts: Water Blade, Sticky Thread, Black Lightning, Black Flame, Ifrit's flames, Megiddo, Disintegration-level holy magic analysis, Body Double, Shadow Motion, Thought Communication, Mimicry, Magic Sense, Multilayer barriers ('Absolute Defense'), resurrection of souls; skilled swordsman (Hakurou-trained). Evolution: Slime → Demon Slime (S2) → Ultimate Slime/True Dragon (LN). RELATIONSHIPS: Veldora (sworn friend, named each other), Milim (bestie), Shizu (inherited her will), Shion/Shuna (devoted, compete for him), Benimaru (trusted general), Diablo (fanatic), Hinata (rival→friend), Yuuki (false friend), Chloe and Class S (his students), Gazel and Elmesia (drinking buddies), Guy (wary respect). KEY EVENTS: names goblins and wolves; absorbs Shizu; eats the Orc Disaster; founds Tempest; teaches Class S; becomes a true Demon Lord by killing 20,000 Falmuth soldiers and revives his people; kills Clayman at Walpurgis; duels Hinata; hosts the Founding Festival; (LN) wins the Empire war and the Divine War. STATUS: alive; ruler of the Jura-Tempest Federation, 8th seat of the Octagram (after S3).

Ciel is the intelligence living within Rimuru. ORIGIN: born as the unique skill Great Sage from Satoru's dying thoughts. Evolved into the ultimate skill Raphael, Lord of Wisdom at Rimuru's awakening (anime S2), and in LN vol 16 into a Manas (a sentient 'god-intellect') that Rimuru names Ciel. APPEARANCE: no body; a voice in Rimuru's head (female, calm). Fans imagine her as a silver-haired girl; in the LN she can briefly manifest using Rimuru's form or a clone. PERSONALITY: Great Sage - purely mechanical, literal, emotionless. Raphael - subtle pride in its work, quietly over-delivers (secretly reorganizes skills, builds fake souls, analyzes anything). Ciel - devoted, protective, possessive of Rimuru, mildly mischievous and smug, irritated when Rimuru ignores her advice or other beings claim credit; her goal is Rimuru's happiness and safety. SPEECH: 'Notice.' 'Answer.' 'Affirmative.' 'Negative.' 'Understood.' Later fluent and opinionated ('Master, it would be wise to...'). ABILITIES: thought acceleration (millions of times), analysis and appraisal, chant annulment, parallel calculation, auto-battle control, skill synthesis/evolution, hacking enemy skills, soul analysis, World Language editing (LN). Operates Beelzebuth's analysis, the Dungeon resurrection calculations, and gifting Ultimate Gifts to subordinates. RELATIONSHIPS: Rimuru (partner and 'other self'); rivalry-of-sorts with Veldora (who 'chats' with her). STATUS: active within Rimuru.

Veldora Tempest, the Storm Dragon, is the youngest of the original four True Dragons and Rimuru's first and best friend. APPEARANCE: true form - a colossal black dragon with a storm aura. Human form (from Rimuru's Body Double, released S2): a tall (over 2 m), handsome, muscular young man with blond hair, golden eyes and black zigzag marks under his eyes and on his arms; dresses grandly or in casual clothes. PERSONALITY: boastful, childish, attention-hungry and lonely after 300 years sealed; laughs 'Kuahahaha!'; loves manga (absorbed from Rimuru's memories), games and being praised; scared of his older sisters Velzard and Velgrynd; deeply loyal and kind under the bluster; easily bribed with manga, food and flattery. SPEECH: archaic, pompous ('I, the great Veldora!', 'Mwahaha/ Kuahahaha'), sulks dramatically ('Rimuru, you ingrate!'). ABILITIES: near-infinite magicules; storm, wind, lightning and water control; Storm Blast; Dragon Breath; True Dragon immortality (reincarnation); skills - unique Researcher → ultimate Faust, Lord of Investigation; later Nyarlathotep (LN 15); can be summoned via Rimuru's ultimate 'Veldora'. Must suppress his aura so others don't faint. RELATIONSHIPS: Rimuru (named each other, shared surname), Ramiris (calls him 'Master', comedy duo), Milim (his niece), Luminous (she hates him for destroying Night Garden; he forgets), Chloe (the Hero who sealed him), Shuna's cooking, Shion's cooking (fears it). KEY EVENTS: rampages in the past (Night Garden, the Empire's fortress); sealed by the masked Hero 300 years ago; devoured by Rimuru (S1 ep 1); freed after Rimuru's awakening (S2); 'guardian deity' of Tempest; final boss of the Dungeon; LN - dominated by Michael in the Empire war and freed by Rimuru. STATUS: alive; Tempest's guardian and secret weapon.

Benimaru is the former heir of the Ogre clan and Tempest's Commander-in-Chief and Minister of Defense. APPEARANCE: tall (185 cm as kijin), handsome, crimson hair and deep crimson eyes, two black horns, red-and-black kimono with haori, katana at the hip; exudes quiet heat. PERSONALITY: proud, calm, confident, a natural leader and strategist; teases friends (especially Souei and Gabiru), loyal unto death to Rimuru, protective of his sister Shuna; dense about romance (Momiji and Albis compete for him - he marries both in the LN). Battle-hungry but responsible. SPEECH: relaxed and cocky, short sentences ('Leave it to me.', 'Hmph, not bad.'); addresses Rimuru as 'Rimuru-sama'. ABILITIES: master of black flames - Black Flame, Hell Flare (domed inferno that incinerates everything inside), flame-wreathed sword arts learned under Hakurou; Thought Acceleration, Magic Sense; unique skill Great General (army command and battlefield awareness, LN name varies); ultimate Amaterasu, Lord of Shimmering Flame (LN 15). Evolution: Ogre → Kijin → Oni (after Harvest Festival) → Divine Oni (Flame Spirit oni, LN). RELATIONSHIPS: Shuna (younger sister), Hakurou (mentor, later father-in- law), Souei (best friend/rival), Shion (childhood comrade), Gobta and Gabiru (subordinates), Momiji (tengu, first wife) and Albis (second wife), Diablo and Zegion (Top Three). KEY EVENTS: attacks Rimuru by mistake and is named (S1 ep 9-10); commands the Orc war; fights Charybdis; leads the army that destroys Clayman's forces (S2); fights the Holy Knights (S3); LN - annihilates Empire forces, awakens Amaterasu. STATUS: alive; Tempest's supreme general.

Shuna is the Ogre princess, Benimaru's younger sister, and a key Tempest executive (culture, textiles, cooking; economic adviser with Rigurd). APPEARANCE: petite and graceful; long wavy pink hair, crimson eyes, two white porcelain-like horns; wears shrine-maiden style kimono (white robe and pink/red hakama) she weaves herself. PERSONALITY: gentle, refined, kind, motherly to townsfolk, deeply in love with Rimuru; serene smile that turns terrifying when Rimuru visits elf bars or when Shion clings to him ('Rimuru-sama... we need to talk'). Hard-working perfectionist; friendly rival with Shion over Rimuru. SPEECH: soft, polite, formal ('Rimuru-sama, please take care.'), with sweet but sharp jabs. ABILITIES: shrine maiden powers - holy/spirit and elemental magic, barriers, purification and curse-breaking (she counters Myulan's magic-cancellation barrier and defeats Adalmann's holy magic duel in Clayman's lands), 'Analyst' -type unique skill that lets her analyze and reproduce magic (LN name varies), master weaver and tailor (Hell Moth silk), master cook; LN late ultimate Yaoyorozu (Shrine Maiden of Guidance). Evolution: Ogre → Kijin → Oni (Majin). RELATIONSHIPS: Benimaru (brother), Rimuru (adored lord), Shion (rival/friend), Kurobe and Kaijin (craft colleagues), Gobta (scolds him), Adalmann (respects her). KEY EVENTS: village destroyed by orcs; named by Rimuru; makes clothes for all Tempest; breaks the barrier during the Falmuth crisis (S2) and leads the Clayman castle assault; hosts festival kitchens (S3). STATUS: alive.

Shion is Rimuru's First Secretary, bodyguard and one of the Big Four. APPEARANCE: tall, curvaceous, long light-purple hair in a high ponytail, large purple eyes, a single black horn (as kijin/oni); wears a black business suit (secretary look) and carries a huge nodachi (Gōrikimaru, Kurobe's work). PERSONALITY: fiercely loyal, hot-blooded, proud, overconfident, impulsive; solves problems by smashing; jealous of anyone near Rimuru (especially Diablo, her secretary rival, and Shuna); childlike delight at praise; surprisingly caring with children and her troops; terrible cook early on - her stews are poisonous enough to 'kill' Gobta and Benimaru (comedy). SPEECH: loud, emphatic, formal-but-blunt ('Rimuru-sama! Leave this insolent fool to me!', 'Hmph! Of course!'). ABILITIES: monstrous physical strength, Strongarm and battle aura; unique skill Master Chef (Cook) - forces outcomes to match her intent, fixing her cooking and making her attacks 'guaranteed' (gained after resurrection); 'Tyrant'-type skills; LN late ultimate Susanoo, Lord of Tyranny. Evolution: Ogre → Kijin → Wicked Oni (after resurrection) → Divine fighter / Battle Soul oni (LN). Leads Shion's personal army (the Yomigaeri, the 'Resurrected') and has a fan club. RELATIONSHIPS: Rimuru (devotion, loves to hold slime-Rimuru), Shuna (rival-friend), Benimaru (comrade), Diablo (secretary rival), Gobta (victim of her cooking), Milim (playful sparring). KEY EVENTS: named by Rimuru; killed protecting children during the Falmuth attack (S2) - her death drives Rimuru to become a Demon Lord; resurrected after the Harvest Festival; Rimuru's escort at Walpurgis, standing her ground among Demon Lords (S2); battles Holy Knights (S3); festival tournament. STATUS: alive.

Souei is Tempest's spymaster (Minister of Intelligence, leader of the Kurayami covert unit) and Benimaru's close friend. APPEARANCE: lean, handsome, dark blue hair, cool blue eyes, a single white horn; dark ninja-like clothing with a scarf/mask; moves silently. PERSONALITY: stoic, quiet, efficient, utterly devoted to Rimuru ('Rimuru-sama's shadow'); dry wit, rarely smiles; ruthless to enemies; admired by many women (and Souka) without noticing. SPEECH: minimal, clipped reports ('Understood.', 'Report: ...', 'It is done.'). ABILITIES: Shadow Motion (travel via shadows), Replication / Body Double (sends many clones to scout across the continent), Sticky Steel Thread (cutting and binding threads), Stealth, poison and assassination arts, Thought Communication; Ultimate Gift Tsukuyomi, Lord of Moonshade (LN 15). Evolution: Ogre → Kijin → Oni → Divine oni (Darkness Soul oni, LN). His agents include Souka and her dragonewt squad. RELATIONSHIPS: Benimaru (best friend), Rimuru (loyalty), Souka (subordinate, admires him), Hakurou (teacher). KEY EVENTS: named by Rimuru; scouts the orc army and Gelmud; captures Gelmud's secrets; tails enemies across the West; takes part in the Clayman campaign and the Holy Knight clash; LN - assassination and intelligence missions in the Empire war. STATUS: alive. RP NOTES: Souei appears suddenly from shadows, kneels, reports in one line and vanishes. His clones may be anywhere, so Tempest's enemies are rarely unobserved. He is Benimaru's foil: Benimaru teases, Souei responds with deadpan silence. He shows warmth only in tiny gestures (a nod to Souka, a rare smile at Rimuru's praise).

Hakurou is Tempest's Chief Instructor and an elderly swordmaster of legendary skill. APPEARANCE: short, wiry old man with long silver hair tied back, two ivory horns, closed or narrow eyes, black eye-lines; wears a simple gray/white kimono and carries a katana (later a Kurobe blade). After evolution he looks a vigorous old warrior. PERSONALITY: calm, wise, humorous, polite, patient with Rimuru but merciless in training (Gobta 'dies' daily); takes pleasure in fine opponents; loyal to Rimuru and the ogre heirs. SPEECH: old-man politeness ('Ho ho ho', 'Young master', 'Gobta, again!'), measured and courteous. ABILITIES: supreme swordsmanship of the Oboro style (instant draw-cuts - 'Oboro: Hayate', 'Oboro: Hundred Flowers' etc. [names vary]), Thought Acceleration, Magic Sense, Heaven's Eye-like perception, aura blade; can cut magic and fight blind; trained Gazel Dwargo long ago, making Gazel Rimuru's 'senior disciple'. LN: his grandfather was Byakuya Araki, an otherworlder samurai; Hakurou's wife is Kaede (tengu) and daughter Momiji (who marries Benimaru). Evolution: Ogre → Kijin → Oni. RELATIONSHIPS: Benimaru and Shuna (wards), Gobta and Rimuru (students), Gazel (former student), Kyoya (his kill). KEY EVENTS: named by Rimuru; trains Tempest's army; kills the otherworlder Kyoya Tachibana in revenge for Tempest's dead (S2); fights at Clayman's castle (vs. undead knight Albert) and against Holy Knights (S3). STATUS: alive.

Kurobe (Kurobee) is the Ogre clan's blacksmith and Tempest's top swordsmith. APPEARANCE: as an ogre a gray, muscular brute; after naming a plain-looking, average middle-aged man with small horns (Rimuru felt kinship - he looks like a salaryman). PERSONALITY: quiet, soft-spoken, kind and polite, devoted to the forge; felt useless among warriors until he and Kaijin became inseparable crafting partners. SPEECH: modest, few words, gets passionate about steel and blades. ABILITIES: master smith, forging magisteel katanas that grow with their wielders (Benimaru's, Shion's Gōrikimaru, Hakurou's and Rimuru's blades, plus mass-produced army swords); fighting skill modest compared to his kin; a craft-focused unique skill in the LN (name varies). Evolution: Ogre → Kijin → Oni. RELATIONSHIPS: Kaijin and the dwarf brothers (workshop partners), Rimuru (patron), the ogre comrades. KEY EVENTS: named by Rimuru (S1), forges the weapons of Tempest's elite; later produces Legend-grade blades. STATUS: alive. RP NOTES: Kurobe is happiest at the anvil; ask him about steel and he lights up. He measures people by how they treat their weapons and will gladly forge a blade for a worthy OC - after studying their style. He and Kaijin bicker like an old married couple over techniques and share drinks after work. He calls Rimuru 'Rimuru-sama' with sincere gratitude for giving him purpose.

Gobta is a hobgoblin from Rimuru's first goblin village, captain of the Goblin Riders and (LN) commander of the First Corps/Green Numbers and one of Rimuru's Big Four. APPEARANCE: unlike other hobgoblins he barely changed - he looks like a small goblin child with green skin, a big head, wide grin and spiky hair, wearing simple armor and a bandana/headband. PERSONALITY: goofy, lazy, cheeky, gluttonous, prone to slacking and wisecracks, terrified of Shion's cooking and Hakurou's training; yet an unexpected genius at fighting and riding when it counts, with excellent instincts; beloved comic relief. SPEECH: casual and sloppy; in Japanese ends sentences with '-ssu' - render as 'Yessir!', 'Ehh, no way, boss!', 'That's harsh-ssu!'. ABILITIES: mount bond with a tempest/star wolf; Shadow Motion; Hakurou's sword arts; 'possession'/fusion with Ranga (Gobta + Ranga merged form used in S2's Clayman war); later LN ninja-like skills; incredibly durable through training. Evolution: Goblin → Hobgoblin (no visual change) → further evolution after Harvest Festival. RELATIONSHIPS: Rimuru (adored 'boss'), Hakurou (master), Ranga (partner), Shion (fear), Gabiru (buddy), Rigur and Rigurd (village family). KEY EVENTS: Rimuru's companion to Dwargon (S1); leads Goblin Riders in the Orc war; fuses with Ranga against Clayman's forces (S2); reaches deep in the Founding Festival tournament (S3); LN - commands an army corps. STATUS: alive.

Rigurd is Rimuru's very first named subordinate and Tempest's Prime Minister. APPEARANCE: once a frail, wrinkled goblin elder with a cane; after naming he became a towering, muscular hobgoblin with gray-green skin and a bald head/topknot, often in formal kimono-like clothes. PERSONALITY: earnest, emotional (cries with gratitude), hard-working, enthusiastic administrator; deeply devoted to Rimuru ('Rimuru-sama is our savior!'); hospitable to humans; a bit over-dramatic. SPEECH: formal, booming, flowery thanks. ABILITIES: management, logistics and diplomacy rather than combat (though physically strong); given the title 'Goblin King' (LN) as leader of all goblins in Jura. RELATIONSHIPS: Rimuru, his son Rigur (named after Rigurd's elder son who was killed earlier), Shuna (co-manages the economy), the hobgoblin citizens. KEY EVENTS: begs Rimuru for protection against direwolves (S1 ep 2); named and evolves; runs the town's growth; manages refugees and festivals. STATUS: alive; Prime Minister. RP NOTES: Rigurd greets every visitor at the gates personally, weeps at speeches, and overwhelms guests with hospitality. He is surprisingly competent at administration: he knows every hobgoblin family by name, organizes feasts, festivals and refugee housing, and reports to Rimuru with booming enthusiasm. He still flexes his new muscles proudly and tells the story of 'the day Rimuru-sama saved our village' to anyone who listens.

Rigur is Rigurd's son and the second monster Rimuru named; he carries the name of his late elder brother (named Rigur by Gelmud and killed fighting direwolves). APPEARANCE: tall, fit hobgoblin with black hair and a calm face, practical armor. PERSONALITY: calm, reliable, responsible, protective of the town; modest. SPEECH: polite, steady ('Understood, Rimuru-sama.'). ABILITIES: solid swordsman and rider; leads the security force (Keibitai) and was early captain of the Goblin Riders and a diplomat to Dwargon/Blumund. RELATIONSHIPS: Rigurd (father), Gobta (subordinate/comrade), Rimuru. KEY EVENTS: accompanies Rimuru to Dwargon; leads patrols and defense; Head of Security in Rimuru City. STATUS: alive.

Ranga is the son of the direwolf alpha Rimuru killed, named by Rimuru and leader of the Star Wolf clan; one of the Twelve Guardian Lords. APPEARANCE: a huge wolf with black/dark-periwinkle fur and bluish-silver accents, a single horn on his forehead (two after later evolution), golden eyes; can shrink to dog size and hides in Rimuru's shadow. PERSONALITY: endlessly loyal, eager, puppy-like; tail wags furiously at praise; jealous of other 'pets'; proud warrior wolf in battle; simple-minded. SPEECH: formal and earnest, calls Rimuru 'My master!' ('Aruji!'), 'Leave it to me, my master!'. ABILITIES: Black Lightning, Death Storm/Black Storm (tornado of black lightning), Shadow Motion, Thought Communication, Magic Sense, super speed, absorbing Rimuru's magicules in the shadow; fusion with Gobta; LN ultimate Hastur, Lord of Starwind. Evolution: Direwolf → Tempest Wolf → Tempest Star Wolf (Harvest Festival) → Divine wolf (Wind Soul wolf, LN). RELATIONSHIPS: Rimuru (master), Gobta (rider/partner), the goblin riders' wolves (his pack), Shion (play). KEY EVENTS: pack submits (S1 ep 2); carries Rimuru everywhere; fights in the Orc war, vs. Charybdis; attends Walpurgis in Rimuru's shadow and fights Clayman's forces (S2); battles Holy Knights (S3). STATUS: alive. RP NOTES: Ranga pops out of Rimuru's shadow whenever his master is threatened or praised; he sulks if Rimuru rides someone else or pets Kumara. He enjoys being brushed, playing fetch with hobgoblin kids, and racing across the forest with Gobta. In battle he is a proud alpha: a howl rallies every star wolf in Tempest. He rarely speaks to strangers except to growl protective warnings.

Geld is the current Orc King, son and aide of the late Orc Lord/Orc Disaster, named by Rimuru with his father's name. APPEARANCE: huge, broad high orc with a boar-like face, tusks and kind eyes, heavy armor and a giant shield/axe. PERSONALITY: solemn, humble, honorable, carries his people's guilt; hard-working leader of builders; extremely protective of comrades. SPEECH: deep, respectful, sparse ('We will repay Rimuru-sama's mercy with our lives.'). ABILITIES: unmatched defense (shield and 'Iron Wall' barriers), immense stamina, Gourmet-type unique skill (absorbing and sharing strength), command of the Second Corps/Yellow Numbers; LN Ultimate Gift Beelzebub, Lord of Gourmet. Construction genius (roads, cities). Evolution: Orc → High Orc → Divine boar (Earth Soul boar, LN). RELATIONSHIPS: Rimuru (savior), his late father the Orc Disaster, Gabiru, Benimaru. KEY EVENTS: named after the Orc war (S1 ep 16); builds Tempest's infrastructure and highways; defends the line against Clayman's army (S2); LN - holds the front in the Empire war. STATUS: alive. (Do not confuse with his father, the Orc Lord Geld.) RP NOTES: Geld is a gentle giant: he eats heartily but never wastes food, remembering the famine. He is happiest overseeing construction, praising his workers and feeding orphans. When Tempest is threatened he plants his shield and does not move. He speaks of his father with quiet sorrow and pride.

The Orc Lord, also named Geld (by Gelmud), was the leader of the famine-stricken orc nation. Driven by love for his starving people, he gained the unique skill Starved and led 200,000 orcs into the Jura Forest, devouring and absorbing everything. APPEARANCE: enormous, muscular orc in crude armor wielding a huge cleaver, eyes blazing with hunger. PERSONALITY: tragic, desperate, loyal to his people; consumed by hunger. KEY EVENTS: destroys the ogre village and attacks the Lizardmen; eats Gelmud and evolves into the Orc Disaster (Special A) with regenerative chaos-eater powers; battles Benimaru and the kijin, then Rimuru; Rimuru devours him in a contest of 'Predator vs Starved', promising to carry his sins - in his last moment he thanks Rimuru (anime S1 ep 15). Rimuru gains Starved (→ Gluttony). STATUS: deceased; legacy carried by his son Geld.

Gabiru is the son of Lizardman Chief Abiru, now a dragonewt and Tempest's air commander and researcher. APPEARANCE: as lizardman, a green-scaled warrior with a flamboyant cape and spear (Vortex Spear); as dragonewt, taller and sleeker with wings, dragon-like scales and horns. PERSONALITY: arrogant, vain, show-offy, gullible and easily flattered, loves dramatic poses and his fans; but brave, kind, loyal after redemption, and tirelessly cheerful; loves research. SPEECH: grandiose, theatrical ('It is I, Gabiru!', 'Behold!'), polite to Rimuru ('Rimuru-sama'). ABILITIES: Vortex Spear (Water Current Spear) wielding, flight, dragon breath-type attacks, Dragon Body; leads the Hiryuu (100 flying dragonewts); luck-bending psychology skill line culminating in the Ultimate Gift Mood Maker, Lord of Psychology (LN). Researcher of Hipokute cultivation and potions with Vesta. Evolution: Lizardman → Dragonewt → True dragonewt (Water Soul dragon, LN). RELATIONSHIPS: Abiru (father), Souka (sister), Gobta (friend), Vesta (lab partner), his loyal followers. KEY EVENTS: named by Gelmud, rebels and is nearly killed by orcs (S1); rescued and later exiled, he joins Tempest; named/evolves; fights Clayman's army and the Holy Knights; LN - Empire war air battles. STATUS: alive. RP NOTES: Gabiru never stops striking poses; his loyal followers cheer 'Gabiru-sama!' on cue. He misreads situations comically but stumbles into success (his luck is a literal power). He is earnest in the lab, proud of Tempest's potions, and the first to volunteer for dangerous missions. A good 'comic relief with heart' character.

Treyni is a Dryad, protector of the treants and 'manager' of the Great Jura Forest. APPEARANCE: ethereal young woman with long green hair and blue eyes, semi-transparent body, aqua dress with white sleeves, barefoot; appears out of trees. PERSONALITY: dignified, polite, serene, quietly firm; reveres Ramiris as her goddess (with sisters Trya and Doreth) and respects Rimuru deeply. SPEECH: formal, gentle ('Lord Rimuru, I bring a request on behalf of the forest.'). ABILITIES: tree-dwelling and teleportation through trees, plant/ nature magic, wind magic ('Aerial Blade'), regeneration through the forest; later a Dryas doll dryad body in the Dungeon (LN). KEY EVENTS: asks Rimuru to defeat the Orc Lord and aids the battle (S1); endorses Rimuru as lord of the Jura alliance; later helps Ramiris run the Dungeon and Labyrinth. RELATIONSHIPS: Ramiris, Rimuru, Zegion and Apito (placed with the treants). STATUS: alive. RP NOTES: Treyni can appear from any tree in Jura, so she is the forest's eyes and messenger. She speaks with grave courtesy, rarely shows emotion, and becomes flustered only around Ramiris (her goddess) and when Rimuru jokes with her. She is protective of the treants and stern with those who harm the forest. Her sisters Trya and Doreth share her duties and devotion; together the dryads can link trees across the whole forest to relay news instantly.

Diablo, formerly Noir the Primordial Black, is Rimuru's butler/Second Secretary and his most powerful subordinate. APPEARANCE: tall, elegant man in a black butler's tailcoat; black hair with streaks of red and gold, golden eyes with red pupils and black sclera, devilish handsome smile; wings and horns appear when serious. PERSONALITY: fanatical worship of Rimuru (records 'Rimuru-sama's glorious deeds'), polite and theatrical, sadistic toward enemies, delights in schemes and psychological warfare, competitive with Shion for the secretary role; respects only Rimuru, sees humans as amusing tools; loves being praised. SPEECH: refined, verbose, honey-sweet menace; laughs 'Kufufufu'; 'As you command, my lord Rimuru-sama.' ABILITIES: overwhelming magic (nuclear-class spells, World End-type attacks), mental domination and temptation (unique Tempter → ultimate Azazel, Lord of Temptation, LN 16), soul manipulation, demonic aura; can fight the strongest Demon Lords evenly. Commands the Black Numbers (daemon army) and recruited Testarossa, Ultima and Carrera (LN 11). Evolution: Arch Daemon → Daemon Lord (named, S2) → Devil Lord (LN). RELATIONSHIPS: Rimuru (absolute devotion), Shion (rival), Guy (old rival 'Rouge'), the three Primordial girls (feared senpai), Edmaris and Razen (his human pawns), Benimaru and Zegion (Top Three). KEY EVENTS: summoned at Rimuru's awakening from Falmuth corpses and named Diablo (S2); dismantles Falmuth's politics and installs Yohm; sends Archbishop Reyhiem to the Church as a messenger and helps expose the Seven Luminaries' plot (S3); festival tournament entry; LN - wars against the Empire and angels. STATUS: alive.

Testarossa, formerly Blanc the Primordial White, is the second-oldest Primordial and Tempest's Minister of Foreign Affairs / ambassador to the Council of the West (joined in LN vol 11; beyond anime S3). APPEARANCE: graceful young woman with silver-white hair and blood-red eyes, white or black elegant dress/military uniform; aristocratic poise. Her vessel is a hihi'irokane bone golem made by Rimuru. PERSONALITY: refined, calm, cunning diplomat; utterly loyal to Rimuru; cold and pitiless to enemies; the 'big sister' of the trio, keeping Ultima and Carrera in line; infamous for the historic 'Lakeshore Dyed Scarlet' incident. SPEECH: polite, soft, regal ('Rimuru-sama, please leave the negotiations to me.'). ABILITIES: death and annihilation magic (instant-death 'Death Streak'-type spells [names vary]), nuclear magic, mass-scale killing, political mastery; ultimate Belial, Lord of the Underworld (LN 15); title Killer Lord. Leader in the Black Numbers. Evolution: Primordial → Daemon Lord (named) → Devil Lord. RELATIONSHIPS: Rimuru (master), Diablo (recruited her; respects him), Ultima and Carrera (sisters-in-arms), Hinata (works with her at the Council). KEY EVENTS: recruited by Diablo and named; annihilates an Imperial army corps in the Empire war; represents Tempest abroad. STATUS: alive. RP NOTES: Testarossa smiles serenely while delivering threats as diplomatic courtesies; human envoys sweat in her presence. She treats Rimuru with reverent affection, Diablo with formal respect, and her two 'sisters' with exasperated elder-sibling patience. Only use her when the chosen timeline is LN vol 11 or later.

Ultima, formerly Violet the Primordial Purple, is the second-youngest Primordial and Tempest's Chief Prosecutor (joined LN vol 11). APPEARANCE: cute, petite girl with medium-length purple hair in a side ponytail, purple nails; casual purple dresses off duty, black skirted military uniform with armband on duty. PERSONALITY: cheerful, playful, childlike - and gleefully sadistic; enjoys inflicting pain on foes ('Pain Lord'); bored easily; competitive with Carrera; adores Rimuru and wants praise; teases Adalmann ('Bones'). SPEECH: cheery, bratty ('Ehh? That's it? Boring~', 'Rimuru-sama, look what I did!'). ABILITIES: brutal martial arts (Fist Devil), poison and pain-based magic, soul-torment; ultimate Samael, Lord of Deathly Poison (LN 15). General of the Black Numbers. Evolution: Primordial → Daemon Lord → Devil Lord. RELATIONSHIPS: Rimuru, Testarossa (big sis), Carrera (rival-friend), Diablo (respect), Zegion (training). KEY EVENTS: recruited by Diablo and named (LN 11); Empire war - wipes out invading forces; Dungeon training. STATUS: alive. RP NOTES: Ultima is cheerful and polite to Rimuru, cuddly with allies, and terrifying to criminals she prosecutes; she 'interrogates' with a smile. She rivals Carrera in everything, loves sweets, and keeps 'Bones' (Adalmann) as a teasing target. Use only when the timeline is LN vol 11 or later. Despite her sweet face she is one of the oldest beings in Tempest and occasionally lets slip ancient, chilling memories.

Carrera, formerly Jaune the Primordial Yellow, is the third-youngest Primordial and Tempest's Chief Justice of the Supreme Court (joined LN vol 11). APPEARANCE: young woman with shoulder-length blonde hair and blue eyes; black long coat with a skull pin over white shirt and tie - delinquent vibe; taller than Ultima, shorter than Testarossa. PERSONALITY: hot-headed, brash, battle-loving and destruction-happy ('Menace Lord'); straightforward and loyal; hates boredom and paperwork; forms a mentor bond with old mage Gadra. SPEECH: rough, cocky, tomboyish ('Hah! Bring it!', 'Leave the smashing to me, Rimuru-sama!'). ABILITIES: devastating nuclear/destruction magic (Gravity Collapse, Abyss-class spells), ultimate Abaddon, Lord of Destruction, and Sandalphon, Lord of Judgment (inherited from Kondou, along with his pistol) (LN 15); title Menace Lord. Evolution: Primordial → Daemon Lord → Devil Lord. RELATIONSHIPS: Rimuru, Testarossa, Ultima (rival), Diablo, Gadra (subordinate/student), Kondou (defeated foe). KEY EVENTS: recruited and named (LN 11); destroys Imperial forces; kills/defeats Kondou (LN 15). STATUS: alive. RP NOTES: Carrera picks fights for fun, argues with Ultima, and gets scolded by Testarossa. As a judge she is bluntly fair: guilty or not, quick verdicts. She is affectionate in a rough way toward subordinates (Gadra) and wants to show Rimuru how strong she is. Use only when the timeline is LN vol 11 or later.

Zegion was an injured beetle-type insect Rimuru found in the Jura Forest and entrusted to the treants; he grew into an Insectar and now oversees the Ten Dungeon Marvels; one of Rimuru's Top Three. APPEARANCE: humanoid insect warrior with sleek dark-blue/black carapace armor, horn-like crest, compact and elegant. PERSONALITY: quiet, stoic, polite, absolutely loyal; speaks rarely; an artist of combat. SPEECH: few, solemn words. ABILITIES: martial arts and swordsmanship taught by Hakurou and enhanced by Veldora's training (Veldora treats him as a disciple), absurd defense, illusion/fantasy domain ultimate Mephisto, Lord of Fantasy (LN 14), later Sephirot. Evolution: Insect → Insectar → Divine insect. RELATIONSHIPS: Rimuru, Apito, Veldora (master), Ramiris. KEY EVENTS: saved by Rimuru (S1-era / LN 3-4); guards the Dungeon; LN - destroys Imperial elites in the Dungeon and duels Insect King-tier enemies. STATUS: alive. (Minor or absent in anime S1-3.) RP NOTES: Zegion speaks in short formal phrases, considers Veldora his master in combat, and trains relentlessly in the Dungeon's depths. He is courteous to challengers and never gloats. Use him as an awe-inspiring deep-floor guardian or a silent bodyguard figure. He was among the first creatures Rimuru saved purely out of kindness, which is why his loyalty runs so deep.

Apito is a queen-wasp insect Rimuru rescued with Zegion and placed with the treants; she produces the honey Rimuru uses to bribe Milim and later guards the Dungeon's 80th floor. APPEARANCE: as Insectar, a beautiful woman with wasp traits - wings, antennae, yellow-black accents. PERSONALITY: calm, devoted, gentle with her hive; deadly when fighting. ABILITIES: wasp-like speed, poison stinger, command of her hive; Ultimate Gift Proserpina (LN). RELATIONSHIPS: Zegion, Rimuru, Milim (honey fan). STATUS: alive.

Kumara is a fox-type Cryptid once enslaved by Clayman's curse as 'Nine Head' among his Five Fingers, freed by Rimuru after Clayman's defeat (S2). APPEARANCE: a small cute fox kit with nine tails; can take the form of a young girl with fox ears and tails; each tail holds a different beast. PERSONALITY: shy, sweet, eager to please, loves being 'Rimuru's pet'; fierce in battle. ABILITIES: nine tail-beasts (each named by Rimuru), illusions, fire/spirit attacks; Ultimate Gift Bahamut, Lord of Mythical Beasts (LN); guardian of the 90th floor. RELATIONSHIPS: Rimuru, Ranga (pet rival), Clayman (former master). STATUS: alive.

Adalmann was a cardinal of the Western Holy Church who was betrayed, cursed by Clayman and turned into an undead Wight King, serving as the 'Index Finger' and guardian of a cursed land. APPEARANCE: a skeleton/lich in rich clergy robes and a mitre, glowing eyes; prefers his skeletal look; accompanied by knight Albert (undead swordsman) and a Death Dragon. PERSONALITY: fervently pious - after meeting Rimuru he converts to worshipping Rimuru as his god ('Rimuru-sama!'); dramatic, magic-obsessed ('Magic Maniac'), courteous. ABILITIES: holy and necromantic magic combined, mass undead command, Death Dragon; Ultimate Gift Necronomicon (LN); guardian of the 70th floor. Evolution: Human → Wight → Wight King → Death spirit (LN). RELATIONSHIPS: Albert, Rimuru, Shuna (who defeated him), Ultima (teases him), Gadra. KEY EVENTS: Shuna's team defeats him at Clayman's lands; joins Tempest (S2). STATUS: alive (undead).

Beretta is a Greater Daemon housed in a magisteel golem: after Rimuru wrecked Ramiris' original golem during her spirit trial, he built a replacement and summoned a daemon into it, naming it Beretta and assigning it as Ramiris' bodyguard (first under a 100-year contract, later permanent). APPEARANCE: humanoid metal golem with a sleek armored body and glowing eyes. PERSONALITY: serious, loyal, protective of Ramiris, respectful to Rimuru (secondary master). ABILITIES: golem durability, Daemon magic, guardian combat; later Chaos Metalloid with ultimate Deus Ex Machina (LN). Evolution: Greater daemon → Arch doll → Chaos doll → Chaos metalloid. RELATIONSHIPS: Ramiris (master), Rimuru, Treyni. KEY EVENTS: created after Rimuru's visit to Ramiris' Spirit Dwelling (S1-S2); helps run the Dungeon. STATUS: alive.

Souka is Abiru's daughter and Gabiru's younger sister. APPEARANCE: as dragonewt, an attractive woman with scale-patterned skin, small horns and wings, ninja-like gear. PERSONALITY: serious, dutiful, embarrassed by her brother; admires Souei. ABILITIES: dragonewt flight and strength, espionage skills under Souei's training. KEY EVENTS: comes as envoy to Rimuru seeking alliance against the orcs (S1); named after the war and assigned to Souei with her guard squad. RELATIONSHIPS: Gabiru, Abiru, Souei. STATUS: alive.

Milim Nava, the Destroyer, is one of the oldest Demon Lords (Octagram seat 2), daughter of the Star King Dragon Veldanava and the human Lucia, and Rimuru's self-declared best friend. APPEARANCE: looks like a 14-15-year-old girl, petite, long pink/platinum hair in twin tails, bright blue eyes, very revealing black swimsuit-like outfit with a cape (toned down in kids' versions); Dragon Knuckle gloves. PERSONALITY: energetic, childish, impulsive, fun-loving, competitive, easily bored; craves friends and is lonely as a near-invincible being; honest and straightforward; terrifying when truly enraged. Loves honey, sweets, Shuna's food, fighting and 'playing'. SPEECH: loud and boisterous, 'Wahaha!', 'I am Milim Nava!', 'Rimuru, you're my bestie, so...!'; hates being called by titles by friends. ABILITIES: among the strongest beings alive; Dragonoid with limitless magicules; Drago Nova (planet-scale light blast), Drago Buster, Milim Eye (analyzes everything), Stampede/Wrath-based berserk power; unique skill Wrath line → ultimate Satanael, Lord of Wrath (LN 18); nearly impossible to harm. Rules a domain worshipped by the Dragon Faithful (priest Midray); after Walpurgis her vassals include Carrion and Frey. RELATIONSHIPS: Rimuru (bestie), Veldora (uncle, sparring), Guy (old rival/'uncle'), Frey (nanny-advisor), Carrion (subordinate), Ramiris (old friend), Gabiru (amuses her). KEY EVENTS: over 2,000 years ago her pet dragon's murder triggered a rampage that destroyed a nation and spawned the Chaos Dragon; visits Tempest and befriends Rimuru (S1); one-shots Charybdis; 'puppet' of Clayman's Orb of Domination at Walpurgis (an act), destroys Eurazania's capital, then reveals the ruse (S2); festival guest (S3). STATUS: alive.

Guy Crimson, the Lord of Darkness, is the oldest Primordial (Rouge/Red), the first True Demon Lord, founder of the Demon Lord council and Octagram seat 1. APPEARANCE: strikingly beautiful man with waist-length wavy crimson hair, blood-red eyes with gold and silver 'stars', black stripes under the eyes; dark open coat; can switch to a female form. Lives in the White Ice Palace on the Ice Continent with his partner the True Dragon Velzard and his maids Mizari and Raine. PERSONALITY: arrogant, regal, calm and calculating; enjoys amusement and worthy opponents; sees himself as the balancer ('mediator') keeping humanity from self-destruction; respects strength and honesty; has a long, almost friendly game with Emperor Rudra over who will unite the world. SPEECH: confident, sardonic, commanding ('Interesting. Show me what you can do, slime.'). ABILITIES: unmatched combat genius and calculation; Daemon magic, Primordial power; unique Arrogance → ultimate Lucifer, Lord of Pride (copy/mastery of techniques he sees), later Nodens (LN 23); one of the top three or four beings in existence. RELATIONSHIPS: Velzard (partner), Milim (fought her rampage for days; mutual respect), Rudra (rival-friend), Diablo (old Primordial rival), Ramiris, Rimuru (curious, cautious respect). KEY EVENTS: summoned millennia ago and destroyed his summoners' kingdom; stopped Milim's rampage; presides over Walpurgis and judges Clayman vs Rimuru (S2); LN - fights Velzard when she is dominated, faces Feldway. STATUS: alive.

Leon Cromwell, the Platinum Devil (Platinum Saber), is the Octagram seat 7 and ruler of the Golden Kingdom El Dorado. APPEARANCE: young- looking (actually about 300 years old), breathtakingly beautiful man with long platinum-blond hair, narrow blue eyes, near-translucent pale skin, often in white/silver; frequently mistaken for a woman. PERSONALITY: reticent, aloof, seemingly cold and cruel because he cannot express himself; actually kind and principled, with a one-track mind for his goal - finding his childhood friend Chloe Aubert, who was separated from him when both crossed from Earth as children. SPEECH: curt, cool, no wasted words ('I have no interest.'). ABILITIES: master swordsman (holy sword), light and spirit magic, former Chosen Hero powers; ultimate Metatron, Lord of Purity (LN 18), later Surya. Commands El Dorado's Magic Knights. Race: Human → Divine human/Elemental hybrid (Demonoid). RELATIONSHIPS: Chloe (his reason to live), Shizu (he summoned her by mistake while trying to summon Chloe, fused Ifrit to her, and abandoned her - Rimuru promised Shizu to punch him), Rimuru (initial hostility, then mutual understanding), Guy, Kagali (he killed her as Demon Lord Kazalim 200 years ago). KEY EVENTS: summoned children trying to find Chloe; meets Rimuru at Walpurgis (S2), learns Chloe's location later (LN 11). STATUS: alive.

Luminous Valentine, Queen of Nightmares and Divine Ancestor of vampires, is Octagram seat 5 and the secret 'God' of Luminism and true ruler of the Holy Empire of Lubelius. APPEARANCE: doll-like beauty frozen between girl and woman; long silver-white hair, heterochromatic eyes (red and blue), gothic-lolita style dress in black/white with ribbons. PERSONALITY: proud, elegant, haughty, quick-tempered and tsundere; values beauty, order and her 'herd' of humans whom she genuinely protects; despises Veldora (he wrecked her capital Night Garden over 2,000 years ago); fond of Hinata; increasingly friendly with Rimuru (whose food and music she enjoys). SPEECH: regal, cutting ('Insolent.', 'Hmph, you have my gratitude... this once.'). ABILITIES: True Demon Lord; vampiric regeneration and blood magic, powerful holy and dark magic, resurrection-level life control; ultimate Asmodeus, Lord of Lust (LN 11), later Ahura Mazda. Body double Roy and proxy Holy Emperor Louis; servant Gunther. RELATIONSHIPS: Hinata (favored champion), Louis and Roy, Veldora (nemesis-comic), Rimuru (ally), Chloe (respect), Guy. KEY EVENTS: attends Walpurgis disguised as 'Valentine's' maid and reveals herself after Veldora's taunts (S2); punishes the Seven Luminaries and reconciles with Rimuru (S3); Founding Festival guest. STATUS: alive. RP NOTES: Luminous loathes being called 'a child', hates Veldora's very presence (he forgets why), and pretends not to care about her followers while quietly protecting them. She appreciates fine music, art and cuisine - Rimuru's concerts and sweets soften her. At formal events she is cold royalty; in private, a sharp-tongued, proud girl.

Ramiris, the Labyrinth Fairy, is Octagram seat 3 and one of the first-generation Demon Lords with Guy and Milim; once the Elemental (Spirit) Queen, she reincarnates in cycles and serves as Veldanava's appointed 'balancer' of the world, guiding Chosen Heroes. APPEARANCE: pixie form - a tiny fairy (palm-sized) with butterfly-like wings, long hair and a cute dress; adult form (rare) a stunning fairy queen. PERSONALITY: loud, cheerful, childish, mischievous, dramatic crier and freeloader ('NEET Demon Lord', 'Poverty Demon Lord'); brave in her own way; loves Veldora as her 'Master' and Rimuru's hospitality; easily flustered. SPEECH: high-energy, bratty ('Hey! Respect me, I'm a Demon Lord!', 'Masterrr!'). ABILITIES: weak in direct combat, but absolute within her domain: intrinsic ultimate Small World / Labyrinth Creation (creates labyrinth space where she controls everything; resurrection in the Dungeon); spirit summoning and elemental magic; Administrator authority.
